Independent CE/KL/mixture and gradient derivation
sources.details: N=2 valid positions. CE=-ln(0.5)=0.6931471805599453 nats/position. K=0.8ln(0.8/0.5)+0.2ln(0.2/0.5)=0.19274475702175753 at T=1. L0.5=(CE+K)/2=0.4429459687908514; L0.25=0.75CE+0.25K=0.5680465746753983. KL=soft CE-H(p), with teacher H constant. Student gradient is [(1-alpha)(q-onehot(y))+alpha*T(q_T-p_T)]/N; alpha directly weights signals and is not derived from teacher reliability. At T=2 p_T=(2/3,1/3), unscaled KL=0.056633012265132426, scaled K=4*KL=0.2265320490605297.

claims.statement: Combine hard-label CE at T=1 and fixed-teacher soft loss as L=(1-alpha)CE+alpha*K; alpha in [0,1] is a chosen signal weight, not an automatically measured teacher reliability. Fixed-teacher soft CE and forward KL have identical student gradients.
claims.scope: This section convention uses K=T²*KL(teacher||student). It is a valid weighted objective, not a claim that alpha=0.5 is universally optimal.
